description_en: Grants permissions to a transit router instance to connect to a network instance that belongs to a different Alibaba Cloud account. Before a transit router instance can connect to a network instance that belongs to a different account, the network instance owner must authorize the transit router instance by calling the GrantInstanceToTransitRouter operation
description_zh: 在转发路由器实例连接其他账号的网络实例前，需要其他账号的网络实例对转发路由器实例进行授权。调用GrantInstanceToTransitRouter接口为转发路由器实例进行授权
kebab_example: aliyun cbn grant-instance-to-transit-router --cen-id cen-44m0p68spvlrqq0000 --instance-id vpc-bp1h8vbrbcgohcju50000 --instance-type VPC --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cen-owner-id 1250123456123456 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GrantInstanceToTransitRouter

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) to which the transit router instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 转发路由器实例所属的云企业网实例ID
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the network instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

VPC: a VPC-connected instance.
ExpressConnect: a VBR instance.
VPN: an IPsec connection.
ECR: an ECR instance
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的类型。取值：

VPC：表示VPC实例。
ExpressConnect：表示VBR实例。
VPN：表示IPsec连接。
ECR：表示ECR实例
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the network instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the account to which the CEN instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 云企业网实例所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: cen_owner_id

parameters.help_en:
The payer of the network instance. Valid values:

PayByCenOwner: The fees generated by the network instance are paid by the account to which the CEN instance belongs.
PayByResourceOwner: The fees generated by the network instance are paid by the account to which the network instance belongs
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的付费方。取值：

PayByCenOwner：表示网络实例产生的费用由云企业网实例所属的账号承担。
PayByResourceOwner：表示网络实例产生的费用由网络实例所属的账号承担
parameters.name: order_type
